traditional: 令到 A 可以 V
jyutping: ling6 dou3 A ho2 ji5 V

english.note: This is the all-purpose construction for saying that a person, thing, or circumstance makes an action possible or gives someone the ability to do it.

examples.english: This new feature can enable us to hand in our homework faster.
examples.traditional: 呢個新功能令到我哋可以快啲交功課。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 gung1 nang4 ling6 dou3 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 gaau1 gung1 fo3
